about: Evani.Dev effects. Each effect is a Cargo feature of evani-fx.

effects.name: Bloom
effects.implementation: Bright-pass, then a dual-Kawase blur over 4 to 5 half-resolution mips, composited additively before tonemapping.

effects.name: Colour grading LUT
effects.implementation: 32³ 3D-texture LUT; per-scene swap with a crossfade.

effects.name: Vignette
effects.implementation: Radial darkening folded into the final composite pass; doubles as the comfort vignette in VR.

effects.name: Film grain
effects.implementation: Animated hash noise in the composite pass, weighted toward midtones.

effects.name: Chromatic aberration
effects.implementation: Radial RGB offset in the composite pass, pulsed on hits and boosts.

effects.name: CRT scanlines
effects.implementation: Scanlines, RGB aperture mask and barrel curvature, applied last at output resolution.

effects.name: Dither and palette lock
effects.implementation: 4×4 Bayer dither, then quantise to the style palette.

effects.name: Pixelation
effects.implementation: Render 3D at a low internal resolution and upscale with nearest-neighbour filtering.

effects.name: Ink outlines
effects.implementation: Depth and normal edge detection in 3D; alpha-dilated sprite outlines in 2D.

effects.name: Depth of field
effects.implementation: Circle of confusion from depth, half-resolution gather blur, focus locked to the player.

effects.name: Motion blur
effects.implementation: Camera-velocity blur with 8 samples; per-object velocity buffer at Ultra.

effects.name: Ambient occlusion
effects.implementation: Half-resolution SAO or GTAO-lite with a bilateral blur; baked AO when it is off.

effects.name: Screen-space reflections
effects.implementation: View-space ray march with a roughness cutoff, falling back to the environment cubemap.

effects.name: Light shafts
effects.implementation: Radial blur from the sun's screen position over an occlusion mask.

effects.name: Lens flare
effects.implementation: Ghost sprites along the sun-to-centre axis, hidden when the sun is occluded.

effects.name: Heat haze
effects.implementation: Distortion texture written by particles, applied in the composite pass.

effects.name: Tilt-shift
effects.implementation: Vertical blur band around the focus line, plus a saturation lift.

effects.name: Dynamic shadows
effects.implementation: Directional shadow map with 3×3 PCF; cascades and resolution follow the tier; blob shadows at Low.

effects.name: 2D dynamic lights
effects.implementation: Normal-mapped sprites lit by point lights accumulated in a light buffer.

effects.name: Day-night cycle
effects.implementation: Time of day drives sun angle, ambient colour, fog and LUT blend.

effects.name: Distance fog
effects.implementation: Exponential height fog in material shaders; also hides the draw-distance edge.

effects.name: Volumetric fog
effects.implementation: Low-resolution froxel volume built in a compute pass, with temporal reprojection.

effects.name: Toon ramp
effects.implementation: Stepped diffuse from a 1D ramp texture, plus a specular blob.

effects.name: Rim light
effects.implementation: Fresnel rim on characters so they read against the background.

effects.name: Baked lighting
effects.implementation: Precomputed vertex colours or lightmaps; no runtime cost.

effects.name: Water reflection
effects.implementation: Planar reflection at reduced resolution with depth-based shoreline foam in 3D; a mirrored, sine-distorted strip in 2D.

effects.name: Rain and snow
effects.implementation: Compute-simulated particles that follow the camera, splash decals, and a wet-surface roughness change.

effects.name: Wind sway
effects.implementation: Vertex-shader sway for foliage, flags and cloth from one global wind vector.

effects.name: Instanced grass
effects.implementation: Instanced blades with distance LOD and push-away around characters.

effects.name: Decals
effects.implementation: Pooled decals (skid marks, scorch, bullet holes) in a capped ring buffer.

effects.name: Destruction and debris
effects.implementation: Pre-fractured chunks or tile removal; debris is pooled, sleeps, then fades.

effects.name: Parallax layers
effects.implementation: Background layers scrolling at different rates and tiling infinitely.

effects.name: Particles
effects.implementation: Compute-shader simulation with instanced drawing for sparks, smoke and dust; particle caps follow the tier.

effects.name: Trails
effects.implementation: Ribbon meshes from position history for vehicles, blades and projectiles.

effects.name: Speed lines
effects.implementation: Screen-space radial streaks plus a camera field-of-view kick scaled by speed.

effects.name: Screen shake
effects.implementation: A trauma value drives Perlin-noise offset and roll, decaying every frame.

effects.name: Hit-stop and flash
effects.implementation: Freeze the simulation for 2 to 6 frames on impact; white flash on the hit target.

effects.name: Damage numbers and tweens
effects.implementation: Pooled floating text, squash and stretch, easing curves for UI and pickups.
